data.name: Wavefront
data.detailed_description:
Step into a high-octane VR battlefield! Pilot towering mechs, launch into fast-paced skirmishes, and feel the scale of mech combat from your own cockpit!

Wavefront is a fast-paced multiplayer VR shooter that combines agile pilot combat with the power of commanding massive mechs. Matches shift dynamically as players earn, deploy, and battle inside massive mechs that reshape the flow of battle.

Core Gameplay

Fight as a pilot in fast, high-pressure VR combat. Running, sliding, wall-running, capturing objectives, using weapons, and evading enemy mechs.

When you earn enough points, you can call in your own Wavebreaker, a humanoid mech that drastically changes your capabilities, role and impact on the match. You’re no longer running from danger, you are the danger.

Pilots and mechs fight on the same battlefield: tight indoor areas facilitate pilot skirmishes, while open zones turn into large-scale mech engagements full of heavy firepower and melee clashes.

Game Modes

  • Tidebreak An elimination race where each kill earns points for your team. First team to hit the score limit wins.

  • Zone Control Capture and hold key areas to gain points while fighting across shifting frontlines.

  • Tidal Defense A cooperative mode where up to four players need to survive escalating waves of enemy units.

Mechs (Wavebreakers)

Each mech is a large physics-driven machine you can enter and pilot from the inside. Your mech turns into an extension of your own body.
Move your arms to swing the mech’s arms, duck to make it crouch, or lean and step to shift its position. Every tracked gesture translates directly into mech motion, letting you fight as if the machine is an extension of yourself.

Choose from distinct mech classes, each built to change how the battle unfolds. Whether you prefer heavy armor, high mobility, or advanced systems, every machine brings its own way of shaping the frontline.
Every variant features:

  • A unique primary weapon

  • A passive ability

  • A left-hand and right-hand ability (defensive or offensive depending on the mech)

  • An ultimate ability that reinforces its role

Teamplay

Wavefront is designed around cooperation. Mech abilities work especially well when coordinated: shield allies under fire, push the frontline together, and combine ultimate abilities to seize control of key areas. Success depends on teamwork as much as individual skill.

Match Flow & Big Moments

Wavefront creates explosive VR set pieces that happen naturally during play: Pilots sprint between mech legs to escape danger, grapple across the battlefield for daring takedowns, and clash in close-quarters mech combat. Coordinated pushes can swing the momentum of an entire match, leaving you at the center of cinematic, adrenaline-fueled moments.

Break through defenses, support your squad, or anchor the frontline.

data.short_description: Intense VR multiplayer mech warfare combined with fast, agile pilot combat. Command powerful mechs, push the frontline and turn the tide together with your team.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any VR-compatible sound output
  • VR Support: OpenXR-compatible VR headset with motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700K or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any VR-compatible sound output
  • VR Support: OpenXR-compatible VR headset with motion controllers + ~2x2m playspace

content_descriptors.notes: Wavefront features VR infantry and mech combat with weapons and explosions. Players experience semi-realistic battles, including gunfire and melee mech attacks. There is violence against enemy characters, but no graphic gore or dismemberment, no sexual content, and no drug or alcohol themes.
